title: Make Your Own Spell
goal: Give your spell a name, a job, and steps.
mascot_lines: A skill is a tiny bundle of knowing how to do something.
When the helper sees the right topic, it loads the matching skill automatically.
Good skills have clear steps and solve one problem really well.
And the cool part — you can share a skill with friends so they don't have to start from scratch.

tier2.rephrase: Order the parts you write to make a spell.

tier3.nudge: First name, then when, then steps. The spell needs all three!

questions.math_tip: To find how much longer, subtract the shorter length from the longer length.

questions.math_tip: The equal sign means both sides have the same value.
